description: 충청북도 괴산군_보행자전용도로 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도 괴산군. 충청북도 괴산군 보행자전용도로 도로명, 지정일자, 운영구분, 운영시간, 위도, 경도, 보행자전용도로폭 등을 제공하는 서비스. Coverage: 충청북도 괴산군. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도 괴산군. Its tags are 보행자, 우선, 공간정보, 국토관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2021-08-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
